summary.en: Slanted comic seams carve the frame into three panels on three beats, each popping in with its own framing of one subject; after a hold the last panel's slanted edge sweeps across and eats the frame.
summary.zh: 漫画斜缝踩着三拍把画面劈成三格，每格硬切弹入，是同一主体的不同取景；定格片刻后，末格的斜边扫过全屏把画面吃掉。

fits: Showing one subject from three angles (whole, part, detail); a beat-driven reveal of a product, a chart or a page; a poster ending.
notFor: Three different subjects that need their own captions to make sense (use a split or a grid scene); calm or minimal films (the cuts are hard and loud).

intent.en: One subject seen from three angles at once, cut in on the beat like comic panels; the layout itself becomes the drum, then resolves into one poster.
intent.zh: 像漫画分格一样踩拍劈出同一主体的三个机位，格子本身成了鼓点，最后合成一张海报。

content.en: Wraps one subject (vector or high-resolution, it is enlarged up to about 2.5×) and three framings of it: whole, closer, one detail; no text of its own (captions are three-angles).
content.zh: 包住一个主体（矢量或高清素材，最多放大约 2.5 倍），给出三个取景：全貌、近一点、一个细节；自身不带文字（旁白框归 three-angles）。

fits.zh: 同一主体的三个角度（全貌、局部、细节）；踩拍揭示一个产品、一张图表或一页界面；引向海报收尾。

notFor.zh: 三个不同主体、靠说明才看得懂（用网格或分屏场景）；安静或极简的片子（硬切很响）。

pairs.note: adds the captions and the headline poster

en: All three panels must show the same subject; three different contents read as a bento layout.
On the beat, with a click per panel; off the beat it is just a layout animation.
Once per film: the panel language is too recognisable to repeat.
zh: 三格必须是同一主体的不同机位；放三种内容读成 bento 排版。
要踩拍，每格一声咔；不踩拍只是布局动画。
一支片一段：分格语言辨识度太高，两段就撞。

upstream.use: 把"格子"当节奏器：同主体多机位定格并列，逐格踩拍劈出；吃拍点
